fusions.name: Spring from Crouch
fusions.desc: Springs you up to 6 tiles onto an enemy for 14 damage, rising to 1.8 times that from full range.

fusions.name: Batted About
fusions.desc: A quick swipe that deals 3 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 40% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Belly to the Grass
fusions.desc: Veils you for 10 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Toyed With
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 8. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (218% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
